owner_decision: 09/23/2026: the owner asked for the PDF path to be built. Only the documents below, and PDFs under a listed path, are read as text; every figure still passes the same evidence checks as HTML, and a figure quoted from a flattened table row is held for human review. The owner approved merging it on 09/23/2026; the starting list is the maintainer’s proposal from the 09/22 gap fill, and the owner may add or remove documents. September 23, 2026 (evening): every PDF a hand-entered figure comes from is approved too, so the amended grid-operators.json rule holds as written; TSMC's 2Q26 transcript is among them, although its host refuses the runner some of the time. This does not change the grid-operators.json decision that no PDF number is hand-entered: these are model extractions under review.

documents.why: ERCOT board update: large-load interconnection queue and data-center share.
ERCOT Constraints and Needs report: large-load queue, approved-to-energize MW, TSP vs studied 2031 peak.
PJM Load Analysis Subcommittee large-load summary: data-center growth PJM plans for 2025-2030.
PJM 2026 Load Forecast Report: RTO summer peak path to 2036 and 2046.
SPP 2025 Integrated Transmission Plan: peak-load headline and its figure path.
MISO long-term load forecast whitepaper: coincident peak and data-center energy.

MISO 2026 Long-Term Load Forecast whitepaper (posted 05/13/2026), a newer edition of the Dec 2024 whitepaper the ledger cites; its figures reach the site only through a reviewed forecast-edition package.
Brynjolfsson, Li and Raymond, "Generative AI at Work" (QJE 2025): the +15% resolutions-per-hour figure.
Google, "Measuring the environmental impact of delivering AI at Google scale": category-2 WUE for 2023 and 2024.
TSMC 2Q26 call transcript: the raised 2026 capital budget. investor.tsmc.com refuses the runner some of the time; a refusal is a source failure with a cooldown, never worked around.
LBNL 2025 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report update (served as a PDF at a URL with no .pdf suffix): 2024 use and 2028/2030 Reference Case.

Alphabet FY2025 environmental indicators assurance letter: campus water by data-center location. The PDF is AES-encrypted; reading it needs the 'cryptography' package alongside pypdf, or it stays a gap named pdf_needs_cryptography.

prefixes.why: PJM's annual Load Forecast Report folder (2020 through 2026 editions); reached only from the load forecast development page.
Load Analysis Subcommittee meeting folders by year (las/2026/..., las/2027/...), where PJM posts its large-load adjustment summaries; postings/ templates are outside the prefix.
SPP's site-wide media library, where the 2024 and 2025 ITP reports sit (/media/2229/, /media/2429/); only files whose name carries 'itp' are approved, so the library's other PDFs are not.
